description: PAID $1.00 via x402 (USDC micropayment over HTTP 402). Returns a one-time, 15-minute download link for a professionally recorded guided-relaxation MP3 in the practitioner's own voice (English or Hungarian). Set 'id' (required) to a valid audio track id obtained from list_catalog. Returns the id, title, language, duration in minutes, the time-limited download_url, a usage note, and a verification block. Returns an error for an unknown id — call list_catalog first to get valid ids.

id.description: Audio track id from list_catalog, e.g. 'AU-05'. Required.

name: get_audio
